control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - spot check of key safeguard at SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on SG-4100 and TX-3002 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 17 January 2006 a planned spot check of SG-4100 and TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the earth leakage and protection setting integrity not effective.
